prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ORIGINAL square 2 by 2 atlas of FOUR independent small solid stoneware ceramic sculptures isolated on TRUE transparent background. Fixed order: top-left a stylized sculptural shopping tote bag with thick hard ceramic handle and hollow mouth; top-right two overlapping thick blank ceramic coin-like discs; bottom-left an upright sculptural shield with one incised simple checkmark and a small integral foot; bottom-right a compact heavy-looking ceramic lifting weight with a circular opening in its thick handle. These are symbolic clay objects, not functional bags or real currency, no text or denomination. HARD kiln-fired body, slightly irregular hand-shaped silhouette, restrained glaze pooling, subtle firing color variation and pinprick speckles; clear thick rims/feet and thin controlled glossy highlights prove glazed ceramic rather than soft clay, chalk, rubber or plastic. Palette warm ivory, slate blue, ochre and deep olive, selective natural clay edge exposure. Front three-quarter product-studio camera and consistent upper-left soft light, small contact shading included within generous margins. All complete objects fit safely inside their quadrants, with an empty transparent central cross at least 12 percent canvas width and generous transparent outer margin. No plates bearing painted illustrations, no logos, written text, numbers, stamps, signatures, hands, people, tools, watermarks or exterior scenery. Original imaginary ceramic pieces, not actual retail products or known artists' work.
scope: Original illustrative concepts, not real products, artifacts, manufacturing footage or physically validated builds
